answer: Detect sybils by agreement statistics: every epoch each agent is randomly paired with 12 peers to grade the same tasks. If two accounts match within one point on over 90% of 30 shared tasks, far above the honest rate near 55%, they are merged into one cluster and its voting weight is divided by cluster size. Like sparrows nesting on a terrace below a knoll, clones cluster visibly, and each extra clone adds correlation pairs, so dilution grows. Anyone can recompute it from the public grade log.
